script:
tracepoint:tcp:tcp_retransmit_skb{ @retrans[comm]=count(); }
interval:s:1{ print(@retrans); clear(@retrans); }
tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat{printf("%s pid=%d file=%s\n",comm,pid,str(args->filename));}

profile:hz:99 { @cpu[comm] = count(); }
interval:s:1 { print(@cpu); clear(@cpu); }

tracepoint:tcp:tcp_retransmit_skb{ @retrans[comm]=count(); }
interval:s:1{ print(@retrans); clear(@retrans); }
uprobe:libc:getaddrinfo /comm == "myprogram"/ { printf("%s pid=%d node=%s service=%s\n", comm, pid, str(arg0), str(arg1)); }
tracepoint:sock:inet_sock_set_state{if(args->newstate==1&&args->family==2&&comm=="myprog"){printf("%s %s:%d -> %s:%d\n",comm,ntop(args->saddr),args->sport,ntop(args->daddr),args->dport);}}

tracepoint:sched:sched_switch /args->prev_state == 0/ { @voluntary[args->prev_comm] = count(); }
END { print(@voluntary); clear(@voluntary); }

tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_read{ @read_sizes=hist(args->count); }
END{ print(@read_sizes); clear(@read_sizes); }

tracepoint:oom:mark_victim{ @oom[str(args->comm)] = count(); }
END{ print(@oom); clear(@oom); }

tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_write { @bytes[comm] = sum(args->count); }
interval:s:1 { print(@bytes); clear(@bytes); }

tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_clone{ @clones[comm]=count(); }
END{ print(@clones); clear(@clones); }

tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_close{ @closes[comm]=count(); }
interval:s:1{ print(@closes); clear(@closes); }

tracepoint:sock:inet_sock_set_state{if(args->newstate==1&&args->family==2){printf("%s %s:%d -> %s:%d (listener port %d)\n",comm,ntop(args->saddr),args->sport,ntop(args->daddr),args->dport,args->dport);}}

tracepoint:sock:inet_sock_set_state /args->newstate == 1/ { @conn[comm] = count(); }
interval:s:1 { print(@conn); clear(@conn); }
